@rarkins is there a difference in semantic in fix / chore when Renovate opens a PR or is it just the new default?

@bobylito it's part of the "conventional commits" approach, which uses "fix" when a commit should bump a patch version or "chore" when it can stay the same. The default Renovate approach is that changes to dependencies are a "fix" as they could change behaviour and hence should bump minor version or more

If you want, it’s possible to configure node or engine updates for fix too. Best to set that in your algolia preset
